The '''Felucian Skullblade''' was a primitive weapon used by [[Felucian shaman]]s in ceremonies and combat alike.

==Description==
Felucian Skullblades were constructed from the skull and teeth of specific native creatures. These creatures grew trace amounts of Force-reactive crystals, similar to those used in the construction of [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], in their bones allowing weapons constructed from them, when [[Force weapon|imbued]] with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], to block lightsabers and blaster fire. Skullblades were rarely seen off of Felucia but were sometimes sold on the black market.

===Variants===
A variation of the Felucian Skullblade was the '''rancor-bone blade'''. The rancor-bone blade was the traditional weapon used by [[Felucian/Legends|Felucian]] warriors on the jungle [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].<ref name="Force Unleashed Novel">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref> Like the Skullblades, the rancor-bone blades were resistant to a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], as discovered by [[Galen Marek]], who encountered several Felucians wielding such weapons during his [[Battle of Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|second visit]] to the jungle world, when the balance of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] on the planet had shifted to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]].<ref name="Force Unleashed Novel" />
